name: Agent Backend Doctor
description: Finds, un-caches and repairs KiroCrew's agent-backend harnesses (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, pi). Fills the host's adapter search when an npm global prefix it does not look in (~/.local/node, ~/.npm-global, a ~/.npmrc prefix, $NPM_CONFIG_PREFIX) holds claude-agent-acp / codex-acp / pi-acp; resets the gateway's cached 'not found' so a backend installed after the gateway started works without a restart; keeps a Bedrock-backed Codex's AWS credentials usable inside KiroCrew's sandbox (an isolated 0600 copy of the configured profile's non-secret keys outside ~/.aws, handed to the codex-acp child explicitly, with a launch preflight and a sandboxed provider-chain probe); one page showing per backend what the host sees, what this mod found, the gateway cache state and the advertised models, with an opt-in CODEX_PATH switch (run the codex you installed) and an opt-in symlink repair into ~/.local/bin. Exposes a readiness read for other mods (installed, cache state, Codex preflight) so a session is only moved to a backend that will start. Unofficial.
